report_name: CBIZ Proposes $7.2M Settlement for 2023 MOVEit Data Breach

threat_actors.name: CL0P
threat_actors.description: The CL0P ransomware group exploited a zero-day vulnerability in MOVEit Transfer software to systematically exfiltrate data from CBIZ, Inc. and hundreds of other organizations in May 2023.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The CL0P ransomware group exploited a zero-day vulnerability in the public-facing MOVEit Transfer application to gain access and exfiltrate data.

attack_patterns.name: Automated Exfiltration
attack_patterns.description: The CL0P group systematically exfiltrated data from hundreds of organizations globally using the MOVEit flaw, indicating an automated process.

malware.name: Clop
malware.description: The CL0P ransomware group, which operates the Clop ransomware, was responsible for the MOVEit data breach campaign. The campaign focused on data exfiltration for extortion rather than on-system encryption.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2023-34362
vulnerabilities.description: A zero-day vulnerability in Progress Software's MOVEit Transfer application was exploited by the CL0P ransomware group to exfiltrate data from numerous organizations, including CBIZ, Inc.

campaigns.name: MOVEit Hacking Campaign
campaigns.description: A widespread hacking campaign in May 2023 where the CL0P group exploited a zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2023-34362) in MOVEit Transfer software to exfiltrate data from hundreds of organizations globally for extortion purposes.

identities.name: CBIZ, Inc.
identities.description: A business services firm that was a victim of the May 2023 MOVEit data breach conducted by the CL0P ransomware group, resulting in the compromise of data for approximately 586,000 individuals.

identities.name: Progress Software
identities.description: The developer of the MOVEit Transfer application, which contained the zero-day vulnerability exploited in the widespread data breach campaign. The company is facing ongoing litigation related to the incident.
